Indian Knowledge System (IKS) is a traditional system of knowledge developed in India over thousands of years.
It includes knowledge related to science, mathematics, medicine, astronomy, philosophy, literature, art, architecture and education.
Mathematics in ancient India contributed concepts such as zero, decimal notation and various mathematical methods.
Ayurveda is an ancient Indian system of medicine that focuses on maintaining health and treating diseases through natural methods.
Indian astronomy developed detailed methods for observing celestial bodies and calculating time and planetary movements.
Yoga is another important contribution of Indian knowledge. It promotes physical fitness, concentration, mental well-being and discipline.
Indian Knowledge Systems are also useful for modern education because they encourage logical thinking, problem solving, creativity and a connection between traditional knowledge and modern technology.
Information Technology students can study IKS to understand how traditional knowledge can be preserved, digitized and made available using modern computer technologies.
